choices.why: The clean white three-seat sofa with track arms and light birch legs is the most Nordic option and keeps the long right wall bright and airy.
The cognac leather bentwood armchair adds the warmth the user asked for, makes a comfortable reading seat by the window light, and its dark frame echoes the black balcony door frames.
The square light-wood coffee table with tapered legs matches the sofa's birch legs and suits the warm wood floor in a classic Scandinavian way.
The chunky flatwoven grey rug adds cozy texture and enough contrast to anchor the white sofa and light table on the wood floor, and it is practical under a coffee table.

answer.why: White, light ash and birch give the Nordic base, while the cognac leather and textured wool rug bring warmth. The dark armchair frame ties in with the black window frames, so the set feels cohesive in this bright, wood-floored room.
